grounding_discussions.best_answer_snippet: Hello Nageshwar, You cannot change the data type of the field you have created in a DMO. grounding_discussions.headline: Python custom code extention deploy via data kits
grounding_discussions.question_body_snippet: Hi, has anyone any experience in deploying python data custom code extensions from one env to another? I can see that data kits have list them as objects that can be selected and they are actually transferred via data kit, but they don't seem to be deployed. Anyone tried that successfully? TIA
grounding_discussions.best_answer_snippet: No — Python custom code extensions are not fully deployable via Data Kits. Data Kits can capture and transfer the metadata/reference, but the actual Python code execution environment and deployment are not promoted automatically.
